name: Norwood Park Playground
description: Children's playground with new play equipment, fencing and surfacing, next to a wet play area with water features. The park also has an outdoor gym, a skateboard park, toilets and a café, and is open 24 hours.

nearby.label: Gipsy Hill station, about 15 minutes' walk
Free parking on surrounding roads; can be limited at busy times
